problem: A repository-native skills/agents/chats borging change updated platform/system-map/canonical-system-map.mjs. Delivery classification treated the .mjs system-map source as executable website work, causing Production Source Snapshot to attempt an unrelated Netlify deployment and terminal closure to fail.
root_cause: The canonical system-map source is machine-readable governance/documentation but was not listed in the non-executable shared-path authority. Production Source Snapshot also lacked path exclusions for the system map and brain delivery control-plane file.
fix: Classify platform/system-map/canonical-system-map.mjs as non-executable shared governance and exclude the system map plus tools/brain-delivery-system.mjs from Production Source Snapshot push deployment triggers.
prevention: System-map-only governance changes must not activate website or portal deployment lanes.
Production Source Snapshot must ignore known non-runtime governance/control-plane paths.
Production Release Readback may still provide explicit deployment-not-applicable terminal evidence for governance changes.
Do not weaken actual website/runtime production gates.

evidence.observed_failure: unrelated Netlify deployment attempted for governance-only system-map change
